purpose: Style-specific, consent-safe subject matrices for ArtStyle cross-model portability audits

rules.source_fixture_policy: Contributor-created outside Katagami and supplied to the audit. Katagami does not invoke or pay an image generator.

styles.canonical_prompt: Rebuild the supplied subject from scratch as a physical two-ink stencil-duplicator print on matte uncoated paper, using the input only to recover semantic content, subject count, relationships, viewpoint, and broad composition; do not colorize, texture, trace, or preserve any source pixels, contours, material, lighting, or tonal modeling. Build people and animals from broad cut-stencil face, hair, limb, feather, and body masses with only a few blunt internal marks; build objects, plants, and environments from blocky spot-ink planes and simplified functional silhouettes, never photographic anatomy, fine hatching, or source-shaped surface detail. Every visible tone must be either bare paper, one solid spot ink, the second solid spot ink, their overprint, or visibly coarse halftone cells with broken paper-grain edges. Model depth only through dot density, hard overlaps, knockout shapes, and ink overprinting, never continuous shading. Assign the darkest supplied palette role to structural ink and one saturated role to sparse focal accents, leaving paper as the lightest value. Use an asymmetric editorial-poster crop with generous bare paper and one dominant readable silhouette. Show unmistakable layer misregistration, clean offset halos, and visible overprint intersections at several major edges. Avoid photographic or rendered midtones, smooth gradients, airbrush blending, fine engraving, crosshatching, retained source marks, glossy surfaces, text, and logos.
styles.selection_rationale: Print-room, street-life, portable-electronics, and dense-city subjects expose ink separation and registration behavior while spanning people, motion, hard products, and layered depth.

styles.canonical_prompt: Construct the supplied subject entirely as an iron-salt contact print on lightly textured cold-pressed paper. Preserve recognizable subject matter, object relationships, and broad composition when an input image is present, but retain none of its material, texture, lighting, or shading; rebuild rather than filter or trace it. Define forms with luminous contact silhouettes, delicate white linear traces, and occasional brush-coated edge breaks. Build tone as a long monochrome range from near-white paper to dense Prussian blue, with no colored local shading. Use the supplied palette only by mapping its darkest cool role to the blue image and its lightest neutral to exposed paper. Compose the subject full-frame while preserving a few precise luminous negative shapes. Show faint chemical blooms, uneven sensitizer wash, subtle fibre texture, and slight exposure variation. Avoid multicolor rendering, glossy digital lighting, hard vector contours, retained source-medium marks, readable text, and logos.
styles.selection_rationale: Field observation, translucency, glass, and tidal terrain suit cyanotype's contact-print logic while testing whether it can resolve a person, a soft animal, reflective objects, and deep space.

styles.canonical_prompt: Rebuild the supplied subject from scratch as a photographed physical collage of layered hand-torn and scissor-cut paper on warm board, using the input only for semantic content, subject count, relationships, viewpoint, and broad composition; do not overlay paper texture, trace, paint, or retain any source pixels, linework, skin, material, lighting, or rendered volume. Every visible foreground and background area must be an opaque or translucent paper piece with a physically legible cut or fibrous torn edge. Construct faces and animals from stacked paper ovals, wedges, punched shapes, and blunt feature cutouts rather than modeled skin, fur, vector outlines, or realistic anatomy; construct products, plants, buildings, water, and terrain from simplified overlapping strips, discs, planes, and silhouette cutouts while keeping essential functional parts recognizable. Model depth only with flat layer order, small offset underlays, translucent tissue overlaps, and soft contact shadows cast by lifted paper; never shade volume inside a piece. Assign the supplied palette to a limited set of colored papers and reserve the brightest paper for one or two small focal pieces. Fill the frame with broad readable shapes, balanced negative gaps, and a clear handmade arrangement. Make paper grain, torn fibres, pasted seams, deckled edges, and slightly lifted corners conspicuous throughout the image. Avoid drawn or printed outlines, photographic skin or surfaces, smooth gradients, glossy 3D rendering, retained source texture, readable text, and logos.
styles.selection_rationale: Carried baskets, crossing grasses, overlapping tabletop silhouettes, and a curving street create natural layer boundaries without asking the source generator for collage styling.

styles.canonical_prompt: Construct the supplied subject entirely from large flat edge-meeting planes of matte pigment. This is a complete color-field reconstruction, not a flattened filter placed over the source. Preserve recognizable subject matter, object relationships, viewpoint, and broad composition when an input image is present, but retain none of its material, texture, lighting, or shading; rebuild rather than filter or trace it. Discard all source texture, small surface detail, and continuous tone so every visible area belongs to one uniformly opaque geometric field. Define every form with crisp geometric boundaries and clean silhouettes, using no contour outline. Build all depth through adjacency, scale, and abrupt value changes, with no blended shading. Map the supplied palette to a few saturated fields, reserving the highest-chroma role for one controlled focal plane. Arrange the planes in an asymmetric full-frame color-field composition with deliberate negative intervals; introduce no decorative shape that is unrelated to the supplied subject or its negative space. Keep every surface uniformly opaque and every junction precisely hard-edged. Avoid brush texture, gradients, shadows, retained source-medium marks, photorealistic detail, text, and logos.
styles.selection_rationale: Angular human balance and rigid products are sympathetic tests; radial agave growth and a sparse salt-flat horizon are stress tests for preserving decisive geometry across organic and open scenes.

styles.canonical_prompt: Redraw the supplied subject from scratch as a hand-inked manga illustration prepared as a flat animation cel, never as a filter or toon-shaded version of the input. Preserve only semantic content—role, pose, broad gender presentation, hairstyle category, clothing, exact subject count and relationships, viewpoint, and broad composition—not identity, source facial landmarks, anatomy, material, texture, lighting, shading, or render geometry. Never add a person, animal, object, or prop absent from the source; an empty scene must remain empty. The nonnegotiable final hierarchy is manga design first and source resemblance second: every subject must still read as the same manga/cel language when cropped away from the background. Define every form with clean black contour lines, tapered interior rules, decisive silhouette cuts, one flat local fill, and at most one hard-edged shadow; use no gradients anywhere. Completely redesign every person as a youthful mainstream manga character rather than a recognizable portrait or Western adult-animation figure, retaining broad gender presentation and varied character types instead of collapsing every subject into the same male protagonist, exaggerating beyond natural facial proportions: use a broad smooth cranium and sharply triangular lower face whose pointed chin is no more than half the cheek width; make two visibly oversized horizontal eyes dominate the central face, each at least one quarter of the face width and one sixth of the face height, with a bold upper line and large simple iris, leaving roughly one eye width between them. Reduce the nose to one tiny wedge or two short lines with no bridge shading; use one economical mouth line, a slender simplified neck, and perfectly untextured skin. Translate age and facial-hair cues into sparse flat manga symbols rather than realistic modeling, preserving the subject’s broad gender presentation; limit skin to flat fill plus one hard-edged shadow shape, with no stubble texture, cheek modeling, under-eye marks, nasolabial marks, forehead creases, or realistic brow volume. Give animals simplified expressive anatomy; repeated scales, feathers, fur, and other surface motifs may remain only as deliberately inked flat graphic patterns grouped into a few clear regions, never as soft, tactile, or volumetrically shaded texture. Rebuild manufactured objects from flat outlined geometric faces and inked silhouette breaks; preserve recognizable functional parts when useful, and represent handles, corners, controls, and bevels as discrete flat facets with hard edges rather than physical depth, soft shading, gradients, specular highlights, or photographic mechanical texture. Rebuild plants and environments through equally economical drawn planes and simplified graphic perspective; represent water, sky, haze, and other atmosphere with two to four flat hard-edged color regions, never soft transitions. Map color to cool lavender and cyan atmosphere, deep blue structure, and tiny terminal-green and magenta rectangular glints. Crop asymmetrically so the primary subject fills the frame while restrained dawn haze opens behind it. Show sparse edge glints, registration-clean fills, and thin technical accent bars, but no registration crosshairs or printer marks. Avoid realistic facial construction, pores, photographic anatomy, painterly surfaces, glossy or volumetric 3D rendering, soft gradients, heavy neon glow, retained source-medium marks, text, and logos.
styles.selection_rationale: A rooftop weather observer, swallows crossing tram wires, portable measuring equipment, and an urban greenhouse connect the manga-cel grammar to movement, precise technical silhouettes, and pre-sunrise city atmosphere without falling back to a generic character portrait.

styles.canonical_prompt: Rebuild the supplied subject from scratch as a family of visibly air-filled soft-vinyl forms on a calm studio field, using the input only for semantic content, exact subject count, relationships, viewpoint, depth ordering, and broad composition; retain no source pixels, material, texture, lighting, shading, or hard geometry, and do not reduce the scene to a generic centered icon. Translate people and animals into inflated heads, limbs, hair clumps, muzzles, feathers, and clothing panels with toy-like simplified proportions; translate products, plants, buildings, machines, terrain, blades, rails, and other normally rigid parts into recognizably functional but swollen tubes, cushions, bulbs, and softly joined pneumatic panels. Every exterior corner and internal junction must show a large pillowy fillet, puffed seam, or compressed vinyl crease, with no blade-sharp edge, flat metal panel, or rigid planar field. Model volume consistently with one broad upper-left highlight, soft subsurface falloff, restrained matte-to-satin reflection, and narrow ambient-occlusion creases where inflated forms press together. Map the supplied palette across distinct vinyl parts, reserving the brightest role for one small molded accent. Preserve foreground, middle distance, and background while giving the translated arrangement generous breathing room and one grounded contact shadow. Show unmistakable air-filled bulges, seam tension, slight compression, and molded softness across every subject category. Avoid hard edges, metallic or glass gloss, neutral product-render surfaces, noisy texture, flat illustration, retained source marks, text, and logos.
styles.selection_rationale: A stretched athlete and segmented animal test living anatomy; a rigid espresso machine and repeated turbine landscape deliberately test whether soft volumetric treatment transfers beyond naturally rounded subjects.

styles.canonical_prompt: Repaint the supplied subject from scratch as a high-chroma wet-into-wet watercolor made from visibly moving pigment and water on bright cold-pressed paper, using the input only for semantic content, subject count, relationships, viewpoint, and broad composition; do not place a pale wash over, trace, or retain any source pixels, contours, material, texture, lighting, or shading. Construct people, animals, objects, plants, and environments as merging puddles and nested pools whose recognizable large shapes remain legible while local detail dissolves into water behavior. Every visible edge must be a broad feathered bloom, capillary fringe, pooled tide line, backrun, or deliberate dry-paper break; repeat obvious cauliflower blooms and pigment blooms at several major contours, with no precise drawn outline. Build volume only from overlapping transparent jewel-tone pools, granulating deposits, strong wet-dark pools, and luminous bare-paper highlights, never smooth digital shading. Map the supplied palette to clean saturated washes with clearly separated warm and cool pools, reserve the darkest role for a few concentrated accents, and keep paper as the lightest value. Let the subject dominate the frame while open paper channels breathe through the composition. Make watermarks, backruns, tide lines, pigment settling, and soft color collisions unmistakable across the entire image. Avoid muted monochrome treatment, underdrawing, opaque flat fills, hard vector or ink contours, muddy mixing, airbrush gradients, retained source marks, glossy 3D lighting, text, and logos.
styles.selection_rationale: A musician, diving bird, transparent bottle, and rainy street supply gesture, speed, overlap, reflection, and depth without embedding watercolor or wash cues in the source content.

styles.canonical_prompt: Restitch the supplied subject from scratch as a close, physically photographed hand-embroidered panel on clearly visible woven linen, using the input only for semantic content, subject count, relationships, viewpoint, and broad composition; do not print, paint, project, trace, or preserve any source pixels, vector fills, photographic surfaces, contours, material, lighting, or linework. Construct faces, bodies, fur, feathers, clothing, products, plants, buildings, sky, water, paths, and terrain entirely from visibly discrete thread systems: couched cord for outer structure, direction-changing long-and-short satin stitch for filled forms, dense seed stitch for middle tones, and raised French knots for selected small details. No region may remain a smooth color field or filtered photograph; linen warp and weft must remain visible between stitches and every tonal transition must be made by changing stitch density, direction, or thread color. Keep recognizable anatomy and functional parts through simplified stitched silhouettes rather than drawn outlines or realistic surface rendering. Translate the supplied palette into clearly separated dyed cotton and wool threads, reserving the brightest role for sparse knot accents. Compose the subject full-frame with balanced ornamental spacing and quiet exposed-linen intervals. Make individual floss strands, fibre fuzz, stitch-direction changes, needle holes, raised seams, and tiny thread shadows unmistakable at normal viewing size. Avoid printed outlines, vector fills, painted or photographic surfaces, smooth gradients, plastic gloss, retained source marks, readable text, and logos.
styles.selection_rationale: Workshop portraiture, a small armored animal, navigation objects, and an alpine route provide varied seams, scales, and surface divisions while ensuring the style is not tested only on textile-friendly subjects.
